svg.title: Two kinds of site
svg.desc: Side elevations, schematic. Left: a single-floor garage whose customer bay is a node of the parking floor (Pecos). Right: a BLift site, where the bay carriage is also a VRC that takes the tray between the street-level motor court and the parking floor (38 Gramercy).

g.text: 38 Gramercy: per the comment in params_38_gramercy.yaml, the BLift is node 26 and VRC 1 takes the vehicle from floor 1 to floor 0. The layouts of the New York sites are not in the snapshots, so the floor plan is not drawn.

g.text: Two kinds of site: a bay at grade, and a bay on a VRC

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: The launcher chooses the bay state machine from the node type. A Bay node gets the standard machine; a BLift node gets the BLift machine, a bridge to its VRC, and the VRC's simulated driver. The planner's VRC
